description: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。

latest_release.body:
# S2Arm v0.5.8

## 修复
- **Windows：用 Apple ID 登录时被苹果拒绝（报 403、登录不上）的问题已修好。随包的签名工具 Impactor 升到 2.7.3。**
  *Windows: signing in with an Apple ID was being rejected by Apple (error 403). The bundled signing tool Impactor is updated to 2.7.3, so sign-in works again.*

detail.readme:
s2arm.com

> [!NOTE] > **Good news: [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) is now the official S2Arm website.** S2Arm is free and open source and never accepts donations; get S2Arm only from [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) or this GitHub repository. **Your own Switch games, running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac.** Game code is rewritten to native ARM64 and runs directly on the device's processor, with graphics going straight to Metal. Your whole library lives in one app, and a few clicks in the Mac or Windows launcher take a game from import to play. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS / iPadOS 18 and later) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later) · Build on Mac or Windows · Android / HarmonyOS coming soon · License: Apache-2.0 · **Bring your own games** [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Download the launcher](https://jhaizhou-ops.github.io/S2Arm/) · [All releases](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/releases) · [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md)

## A native port, not an emulator The game's own ARM64 code is rewritten at build time and then runs directly on the processor in your iPhone, iPad or Mac. There is no CPU emulator in between. Graphics calls are translated straight to Metal, and system services come from a native host. That is where the speed, the low heat and the battery life come from. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#native-port) ## One app, your whole library Every game you import goes into the same S2Arm app; open it and pick what to play. The whole library takes a single App slot on your developer account, so adding a game never means installing another app or spending another signing slot. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#one-app-whole-library) ## Graphical launchers, next to zero setup There is a graphical launcher for Mac and one for Windows. On first launch the welcome page boils everything down to three steps: get this computer ready, add your keys, add your games, with a single primary button at any moment. Everything else is either bundled or fetched in one click, and you never touch a command line. After you click Build, every stage shows its progress, elapsed and remaining time, and disk use. Several games can queue up and build one after another. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#graphical-launchers)

## Let an AI drive Both the Mac and Windows launchers expose a control interface, `s2armctl`. An AI assistant can import games, build, install, follow progress and read errors, and every step shows up in the launcher window. A companion self-check, self-fix and feedback toolkit lets the AI find a problem, apply the documented fix, and, when it cannot, package a diagnostic bundle for you to file. Watch an AI diagnose and fix a real problem end to end: [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#ai-at-the-wheel) ### Have an AI do it for you Send this to your AI assistant (it needs to be able to run commands on your computer): > Please read https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/launchers/macos/skill/s2arm-operator/SKILL.md and then help me install my Switch game on my iPhone. It moves forward with a few commands, and you can watch every step in the launcher window: ```bash /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl start # open and connect to the launcher /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl next # what to do now, who does it, and why /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl diag export ~/Desktop/S2Arm-diagnostics.zip # export a diagnostic bundle if it cannot fix a problem ``` Anything only you can do (system permission prompts, signing in with your Apple ID, tapping Trust on your phone), the AI stops and asks you to do. On Windows, use `s2armctl.cmd` in the launcher folder with the same commands. Windows builds iPhone / iPad packages only, so for problems inside a game export the diagnostic bundle on the phone: long-press the game screen with four fingers for 1.5 seconds and choose Export diagnostics. **Something wrong inside a game** (graphics, frame rate, stutter, crashes)? Send your AI: > Please read https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/skills/player-game-triage/SKILL.md . My S2Arm game has this problem: . Check the settings first, then collect diagnostics; if you can change code, fix it at the root and open a PR, otherwise help me file an issue. ## Tested at scale **211** games surveyed with a **95%** first-try build success rate. **4,700+** test runs on real iOS devices and **1,000+** on macOS. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#tested-at-scale) ## Fast, smooth, and easy on the battery On a 16 GB MacBook Air (M3), from importing a game to a finished iPhone build, completely cold: | Game | Game files | Shaders | Build time | |---|---|---|---| | A 23.5 GB action RPG | 23.5 GB | 1,222 | **6.4 min** | | A 12.0 GB life-sim game | 12.0 GB | 9,315 | **8.6 min** | | A 17.5 GB open-world game | 17.5 GB | 26,999 | **34 min** | A Switch 2 game, measured on an iPhone 17 Pro Max: a **full 60 fps** while the phone is cool, **37–43 fps** once sustained load has heated it up, at about **0.15 J per frame**. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#speed-and-efficiency) ## Platforms | Platform | Support | |---|---| | iPhone / iPad | iOS / iPadOS 18 and later; every game is chosen inside one app | | Mac | Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later; builds locally and plays games right on the Mac | | Windows | Graphical launcher that builds and installs games for iPhone / iPad | | Android / HarmonyOS | Coming soon | [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#platforms) ## Downstream deep ports Some games have a deep port made specially by the community. S2Arm recognizes these games: on export it shows a page explaining the option, and you can switch to the downstream project's route (importing, packing and installing are still buttons in S2Arm, with the downstream project's implementation underneath) or keep the standard route. The registry is [`pack/downstream/schemes.json`](pack/downstream/schemes.json); the contract between the two is the downstream project's document. | Route | Project | Devices | Contract | |---|---|---|---| | D2R-Mobile | [jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile) | iPhone / iPad (iOS 26 and later; Android and HarmonyOS in progress) | [docs/S2ARM.md](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/blob/main/docs/S2ARM.md) | ## Getting started 1. Download the Mac or Windows launcher from the [download page](https://jhaizhou-ops.github.io/S2Arm/) and open it. Building for iPhone on a Mac needs the free Xcode from the App Store, signed in with your Apple ID; the launcher walks you through it. 2. Import your own keys and games. Put the base game, updates and DLC in one folder and import them together. 3. Choose iPhone / iPad or this Mac, then click Build. 4. Follow the launcher to sign and install with your own Apple ID (the Windows launcher ships with the Impactor signing tool), open S2Arm, and pick a game from the library. Back up your saves before updating the app. The release uses the new app identifier `io.s2arm.*`, which the system treats as a new app: saves from the beta builds do not carry over automatically. ## Honest boundaries S2Arm runs 64-bit (AArch64) games. Apple silicon cannot execute 32-bit ARM code, so 32-bit games are outside what S2Arm supports, as are games that need a 36-bit address space. ## Development [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [AI collaboration policy](LLM_POLICY.md) · [Diagnosis and root-fix skills for AI](skills/) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/issues) · [Third-party licenses](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md) ## Thanks S2Arm stands on the shoulders of its community. - **Co-developers**: thank you to everyone who has opened a pull request or issue in this project. detail.readme_zh:
s2arm.com

> [!NOTE] > **好消息：[s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) 已正式成为 S2Arm 官方网站。** S2Arm 免费开源，从不接受任何捐赠；请只从 [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) 或本 GitHub 仓库获取 S2Arm。 **把你自己的 Switch 游戏，原生带到 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。** 游戏代码改写成原生 ARM64，直接在设备的处理器上执行；图形直连 Metal。整座游戏库装进一个 App，在 Mac 或 Windows 的图形启动器里点几下就能出包、装机、开玩。 平台：iPhone / iPad（iOS / iPadOS 18 起）· Mac（Apple 芯片，macOS 15 起）· 在 Mac 或 Windows 上出包 · Android / 鸿蒙即将支持 · 许可：Apache-2.0 · **游戏原件自备** [English](README.md) · [下载启动器](https://jhaizhou-ops.github.io/S2Arm/) · [全部版本](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/releases) · [证据页](docs/validation/证据.md)

## 原生移植，不是模拟 游戏自己的 ARM64 代码在出包时改写，然后直接在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 的处理器上运行，没有 CPU 模拟器夹在中间。图形调用直接翻译成 Metal，系统服务由原生宿主提供。快、凉、省电，都从这里来。[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#原生移植) ## 一个 App，装下整个游戏库 所有游戏导入同一个 S2Arm App，打开后在游戏库里挑一款就玩。整座游戏库只占开发者账号的一个 App 名额：多加一款游戏，不多装一个 App，也不多占一个签名名额。[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#单壳游戏库) ## 图形启动器，几乎零配置 Mac 和 Windows 各有一个图形启动器。第一次打开，欢迎页把事情收成三步：准备这台电脑、放入密钥、添加游戏，任何时候只有一个主按钮。运行所需的组件要么已经内置，要么一键获取，全程不用打开命令行。 点「一键出包」之后，每个阶段的进度、用时、剩余时间和磁盘占用都看得见；多款游戏可以排队连续出包。[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#零配置启动器)

## AI 可以直接驾驶 Mac 和 Windows 启动器都开放了控制接口 `s2armctl`：AI 助手可以导入游戏、出包、装机、查进度、读错误，每一步都在启动器窗口里看得见。配套的自查、自修与反馈工具包让 AI 自己定位问题、按处方修复，修不好就整理出诊断包交给你提交。看 AI 诊断并修好一个真实问题的完整实录：[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#ai-驾驶) ### 让 AI 帮你操作 把这句话发给你的 AI 助手（需要它能在你的电脑上执行命令）： > 请阅读 https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/launchers/macos/skill/s2arm-operator/SKILL.md ，然后帮我把我的 Switch 游戏装到 iPhone 上。 它会用这几条命令一步步推进，你在启动器窗口里看得到每一步： ```bash /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl start # 打开并连上启动器 /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl next # 现在该做什么、谁来做、为什么 /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl diag export ~/Desktop/S2Arm-诊断.zip # 修不好时导出诊断包 ``` 需要你本人做的事（系统授权、登录 Apple ID、在手机上点「信任」），AI 会停下来告诉你。Windows 上用启动器文件夹里的 `s2armctl.cmd`，命令相同。Windows 只出 iPhone / iPad 包，游戏里的问题请在手机上导诊断包：游戏画面上四指同时长按 1.5 秒，选「导出诊断包」。 **游戏里出了问题**（画面、帧率、卡顿、闪退）？把这句话发给 AI： > 请阅读 https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/skills/player-game-triage/SKILL.md 。我在 S2Arm 里玩的游戏出了这个问题：<描述现象>。先帮我查设置、收诊断；你能改代码就按里面的方法根修并提 PR，修不了就帮我整理成 Issue。 ## 经过大规模真机检验 **211** 款游戏完成普查，一次出包成功率 **95%**。**4700+** 局 iOS 真机测试，**1000+** 局 macOS 测试。[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#大规模真机检验) ## 快、顺、省电 在一台 16 GB 内存的 MacBook Air（M3）上，从导入游戏到出好 iPhone 包，全程冷启动： | 游戏 | 原件 | 着色器 | 出包用时 | |---|---|---|---| | 一款 23.5 GB 的动作角色扮演游戏 | 23.5 GB | 1,222 | **6.4 分钟** | | 一款 12.0 GB 的生活模拟游戏 | 12.0 GB | 9,315 | **8.6 分钟** | | 一款 17.5 GB 的开放世界游戏 | 17.5 GB | 26,999 | **34 分钟** | 一款 Switch 2 游戏在 iPhone 17 Pro Max 上真机实测，手机未发热时**满 60 帧**，持续高负载发热后 **37～43 帧**，每帧耗电约 **0.15 焦耳**。[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#速度与能效) ## App Store 免费的 Xcode，并在里面登录你的 Apple ID，启动器会一步步带你完成。 2. 导入你自己的密钥和游戏；本体、更新和 DLC 放在同一个文件夹里一次导入。 3. 选 iPhone / iPad 或这台 Mac，点「出包」。 4. 按启动器提示用你自己的 Apple ID 签名装机（Windows 版已附带签名工具 Impactor），打开 S2Arm，在游戏库里选游戏开玩。 更新 App 前先备份存档。正式版的 App 标识改为 `io.s2arm.*`，系统会把它当成一个新 App：测试版（beta）里的存档不会自动带过来。 ## 诚实的边界 S2Arm 运行 64 位（AArch64）游戏。Apple 芯片不能执行 32 位 ARM 代码，所以 32 位游戏不在支持范围内；需要 36 位地址空间的游戏同样不在支持范围内。 ##
